About the firm

Two decades of protecting what our clients build.

Since 2004, Chambers of Law has advised founders, manufacturers, and multinationals on the intellectual property that underpins their business — from first trademark filing through opposition, litigation, and cross-border enforcement. We keep matters small enough that partners stay hands-on, and broad enough to run a full IP portfolio in-house.

Our approach

How we work

The same discipline we bring to a single trademark filing, we bring to a full portfolio.

Client-first strategy

Every filing decision is framed around your commercial goals, not just the fastest route to registration.

Meticulous prosecution

Clearance searches, class strategy, and office-action responses handled by attorneys, not outsourced juniors.

Global-ready filings

Our Manchester office means cross-border trademark and patent strategy is native to how we practise, not an afterthought.

Our expertise

Contentious and non-contentious, under one roof

From first filing to courtroom enforcement, one team carries the matter end to end.

Prosecution & registration

Trademark, patent, copyright, and design filings managed from search through certificate.

Litigation & enforcement

Opposition, infringement, and cancellation proceedings before the Registry, IPD, and civil courts.

Advisory & watch services

Ongoing portfolio management, watch services, and licensing/assignment advice as your brand grows.

FAQ

Common questions

Yes. Our Manchester office supports cross-border trademark and patent filings, and we regularly coordinate with associate counsel abroad on behalf of Indian and international clients.
Timelines vary with Registry workload and whether objections or oppositions are raised, but an uncontested application typically proceeds through examination within 12–18 months. See our process of registration page for a fuller walkthrough.
For well-defined work such as a single trademark filing, yes. Litigation and complex prosecution matters are typically scoped and quoted after an initial consultation.
Our client base spans FMCG, pharmaceuticals, technology, manufacturing, fashion, and hospitality — any business with a brand, invention, or creative work worth protecting.
